Commentary.Commentary: Right then. That’s it from the coverage of this game. For now, India has moved to the top of the table courtesy of a better NRR. Although they have played an extra game. While, West Indies lose a foot in the table. The action of the Women’s World Cup, 2022 will continue on 13th March. It will be a contest between New Zealand Women and Australia Women. The first ball will be at 3.30 am IST (10 pm GMT, previous day). See you then. Cheers!

Mithali Raj, the victorious skipper, says she is very happy and she could not have asked for anything better. Mentions batting and bowling came out very well. Adds they needed to step up and a special effort was needed and the team delivered. Also says the plans need to be changed in a tournament if the original plan does not work and Kaur and Mandhana played well and the bowlers followed it up. Ends by saying it is good to have youngsters around as it eases out the nerves.

Stafanie Taylor, the skipper of West Indies Womenm is in for a chat. She says she does not feel they bowled well and they did not execute their plans well. Mentions Kaur and Mandhana batted well and they put them under pressure. States the start they got was very good but it was important for one of them to stay there and the others to come and do well but the batters who came in did not capitalise. Ends by saying Dottin is doing well.

What a gesture by Smriti Mandhana! She has decided to share the player of the match trophy with Harmanpreet Kaur. The former says both contributed and it was pleasing to score a ton and they both deserve the award. Kaur says in the last game there was no one to support her but in this game Mandhana was there, they started off slowly but gathered pace as the game went on. Mandhana says they prefer both, chasing or setting the target, they did not get going in the last game and played with a lot more intent in this one. Kaur also says left-right combination is a good thing. Mandhana says she was comfortable on facing pace and Kaur was comfortable in facing the spinners.
Stay tuned for presentation...

Spin it to win it was the formula that India applied! The Indian bowling took a real pounding early on but once they got the wicket of Dottin there was no stopping their bowlers. Except for Sharma, all took a wicket at least. Rana was the pick with three and Rajeshwari was also really good. Overall, it was a clinical show from the Indians.

In reply however, Hayley Matthews and Deandra Dottin began brilliantly. The two added 100 in no time with Dottin scoring a half ton. Once she fell though it was a procession. There was hardly any contribution from the middle and the lower order and in the end they have fallen well, well short.

A thumping win for India and they have handed the Windies their first loss of the tournament. To be honest, it was the innings from Mandhana and Kaur which sealed the deal for them. Tons from the two took India over 300.

It is flatter and on the stumps. Shakera Selman flicks it to fine leg. The batters decide to take two. Although, it was not the case. Deepti Sharma comes up with a moment of inspiration in the field. Meghna Singh throws the ball towards the keeper from fine leg. Deepti Sharma though is the one who collects the ball and scores a direct hit at the non-striker's end. It looks like Chedean Nation is out of her crease and the Indian players are celebrating already. The umpire takes it upstairs to confirm. The replays show Chedean Nation was miles away from the crease. Later, the big screen displayed OUT. Shamilia Connell is the last batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! The experienced Jhulan Goswami strikes and finds the breakthrough which India were looking for. A full-length ball, on middle and leg. Anisa Mohammed flicks it aerially towards short mid-wicket. Taniya Bhatia, the substitue fielder back pedals and takes a sharp catch. With this wicket, Jhulan Goswami also becomes the leading wicket-taker of all time in the Women's World Cup . Shakera Selman is the new batter in.
Commentary.Howout: c sub Taniya Bhatia b Jhulan Goswami

Fuller, outside off. Nation pushes it to cover.

Good length, on the stumps. Anisa Mohammed gets behind the line and defends it with the full face.
Length ball, on off, blocked out.

Full length, on off. Nation defends it out to cover.
On a length, outside off. Anisa Mohammed punches it to cover off the back foot for another single.

Around off. Anisa Mohammed prods and defends it out watchfully.

Around off, Nation blocks it out.

Another one flighted and on off, Nation plays it to covers.
Another one floated up on off, Nationa pushes it to covers.
Another tossed up ball on off, Nationa keeps it out.
Flatter and on off, blocked.
On off, defended.

Big turn again! This lands on middle and then turns square. Anisa looks to defend but is beaten.

Tossed up nicely and on off, defended.
Flighted up on off, kept out.
On middle, blocked.
Just short! Tossed up on off, Nation drives it uppishly but just short of the bowler.

Rajeshwari Gayakwad gets to the ball, picks it up and as she turns, fires it towards the bowler. It is a very accurate throw, just over the bails and the bowler does her job. AA uses her feet and drives it to covers.

On off, this is pushed to covers.

Outside off, left alone.
Tossed up on off, this is kept out.

It is reviewed but replays show the on-field call stays. Aaliyah Alleyne is the new batter in.
Review time! Henry has been given out LBW but she reviews. Looks out though.
This lands on middle, Chinelle Henry looks to flick but misses to get hit high on the pads. It actually hit the top edge and then the helmet.
Outside off, this is hit through covers for one.

Chinelle Henry comes in at number 7.

Just wide! Outside off, Nationa slashes at it, it goes uppishly but wide of point for one.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Hayley Matthews walks back to the pavilion with her hands on her head. Meghna Singh takes two for India and Sneh Rana says hold on and grabs her second wicket. She gets rid of another set batter in Hayley Matthews. India well and truly on top now. Flatter and short, outside off. Hayley Matthews hangs back and tries to cut it away. The ball kisses the edge and Richa Ghosh take a sharp reaction behind the sticks.

A short ball, on the bodyline. Kycia Knight swivels on the back foot and pulls it to deep square leg. She does not middle it and could not get the desired elevation on it. Smriti Mandhana bends forward and takes a really good catch to get India back in the contest. Stafanie Taylor is the new batter in.
Commentary.Howout: c Smriti Mandhana b Meghna Singh

Commentary.Commentary: Full and outside off. Hayley Matthews cruches it through covers for one.

DRINIKS! India will be relieved after getting the wicket of Dottin but for now, one has to feel Windies are slightly ahead in the game. Courtesy they start they got off too, all they have to do for the next few overs is play sensibly and they will be in a very good position to win this game. India on the other hand, need to get Hayley Matthews, they would feel, if they get her, the game will be in their control. An interesting passage awaits.

A maiden for Sneh Rana to follow her wicket-taking over. Brilliant comeback by India. They will now aim to put West Indies Women under pressure with the dot balls. Full, on middle and leg. Knight clips it to mid-wicket.
Flighted, full and on the stumps. Kycia Knight digs it out to the off side.
On off, defended out solidly.
Fuller, outside off. Knight taps it to point. She is eager to get to the other end and keep the runs ticking. But Hayley Matthews denies.
Two dots in a row. Angled in, full and outside off. Kycia Knight defends it to cover on the front foot.
Floated, full and on off. Kycia Knight blocks it out.
Fuller, outside off. Knight drives it into covers for a single. A really good over by Rajeshwari Gayakwad.
Tosses it up, on off. Kycia Knight shuffles to tuck it to the leg side.
Floated, outside off, turns in as well. Kycia Knight stays back and defends it to mid off.
Fuller, on off. Knight blocks it into the deck.
An arm ball, full and on off. Kycia Knight defends it out.
Tossed up, outside off. Hayley Matthews eases it to long off for a single.
Fuller, outside off. Knight pushes it to point.
FOUR! Kycia Knight gets off the mark in some fashion. Flatter, outside off. Kycia Knight bends her knees and cuts it hard through covers to fetch a boundary.
Fuller, on off. Knight defends it out watchfully.
A single as this is worked towards mid on.

OUT! CAUGHT! Sneh Rana finds the crucial breakthrough and she is elated. Deandra Dottin though goes back after doing a lot of damage. She played with lot of pain and delivered for her side. Floated, full and on off. Deandra Dottin gets low and tries to sweep it away. The ball flies off the top edge and goes towards short fine leg. Meghna Singh moves to her right and pouches it safely. Kycia Knight is the new batter in.
Commentary.Howout: c Meghna Singh b Sneh Rana

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, outside off. Dottin leans in and drives it to cover.

FOUR! 100 up for the West Indies Women in 12 overs. A length ball, outside off. Hayley Matthews stands tall and punches it hard through covers for a cracking boundary. With all the running in this over. Deandra Dottin clearly in pain. She goes down on her knees and might get some medical assistance now. Pooja Vastrakar gives away 13 runs in her first over. She takes the field with a heavy heart.
A length ball, on the pads. Hayley Matthews stays back and flicks it to deep square leg. They take two with ease.
Full, on middle and leg. Dottin tucks it to mid-wicket for one. Deandra Dottin putting up a great fight. Giving it all for her team.
Full length, on the pads. Deandra Dottin flicks it to deep mid-wicket. The batters push hard for two.
FOUR! Dispatched! A short ball, outside off. Deandra Dottin hangs back, cuts it hard though covers for a boundary.
Back of a length, on off. Deandra Dottin stays back and tries to pull it away. She gets it off the inside edge and to the off side.
On off, defended.
Tossed up on off, this is lofted over cover for one.
FOUR! Short ball and put away! Angling into the pads, Dottin pulls it behind square on the leg side and this one races away to the fence.
On off, this is blocked.
On middle, kept out.
Misfield and one! On off, this is pushed to cover. The fielder there lets it through. A run taken.
Powerplay 2! Now, 4 fielders will be allowed outside the circle until the end of the 40th over.
Full, quicker on the pads. Dottin fails to flick. 11 runs come off this over.

SIX! BANG! What a knock by Deandra Dottin. She racks up FIFTY in just 35 deliveries. Tossed up, around off. Deandra Dottin dances down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and smokes it over the long on fence. It clears the fence with ease. India under some pressure now.
Floated, on the pads. Deandra Dottin flicks it to the leg side.

FOUR! Deandra Dottin is motoring along really well here. She is still in pain but she is stil doing the job. Tossed up, full and on off. Deandra Dottin comes down the track, lofts it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Fuller, on the pads, Hayley Matthews flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Looped up, on middle and leg. Hayley Matthews blocks it to short mid-wicket.

A direct hit and it is referred upstairs. NOT OUT! Dottin is in! On middle, this is worked to the right of the bowler and the batters go for one. Rajeshwari Gayakwad gets to the ball and hits the stumps at the keeper's end. It is taken upstairs but replays show that Dottin is in.
Safe! Slower and outside off, Dottin looks to go over covers, it goes off the outer half but falls safe over covers for one.
On middle, this is played towards mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Exquisite! Magical again. Fuller and outside off, Hayley Matthews strokes it through covers. This races away to the fence.
Flatter and on off, kept out.
On middle, defended.
A dot to end! On middle, kept out.
On middle, this is pushed to mid on.
Another single as Hayley Matthews plays it on the on side.
On middle, this is worked through square leg for one.
FOUR! Up and over! Brilliant shot. Dottin comes down the track, this is bowled outside off. She hits it over mid off for another boundary.
On off, blocked.

That is a brilliant effort! It would go down as a drop but would have been a blinder had that stuck. Shorter and on middle, this is pulled uppishly to the right of Taniya Bhatia, the sub, at square leg. She dives to her right with one hand stretched out. It hits her hand but does not stay in.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
On off, blocked.
Leading edge but safe! This is slowed up, it lands on middle and turns away. Dottin looks to flick but this goes off a leading edge, lands safe on the off side.
Shorter and on middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Angled into the pads, Dottin works it towards backward square leg for one.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad comes into the attack now. So, spin from both ends now.
On middle, kept out. A good over by Sharma.
Brings the paddle scoop out, plays it fine on the leg side. Hayley Matthews calls for the third. Dottin is struggling but the throw is at the wrong end.
Flatter and on middle, blocked.
On middle, Dottin works it to mid-wicket.
On off, this is blocked.
Fuller and on middle, this is pushed down to long on for one. Courtesy the start, the two can play sensibly against the spinners.

FOUR! Make that 5 in the over and Raj has a worried look on her face and rightly so. Windies are 50 for 0 after 5 overs. This is powered again. Full and on off, this is hit down the ground, over mid off and into the fence.
FOUR! Thumped down the ground! Jhulan Goswami has been taken to the cleaners, you do not say that often. Full and on middle, Dottin smashes it over the mid on fielder and into the fence.
Now follows the three boundaries with a single as this is worked down to fine leg.
FOUR! Down the ground now! Three in a row and these two have got their side off to an absolute flier. Fuller and on middle, Hayley Matthews strokes it down the ground, past mid on for a boundary.
FOUR! It is raining boundaries here! Through the off side now. Fuller and outside off, it is creamed through covers. Races away.
FOUR! Pulled away! Lovely start to this over! This is short and on the body, Hayley Matthews stays back and pulls it over square leg for a boundary.

That is outstanding fielder from Yastika Bhatia, she has hurt herself in the process but has saved two for her side. On middle, Dottin lofts it over mid on. It lands and then slows down near the ropes. Bhatia from mid on, does not give up and at the end, she dives and pushes it back in. Saves two for her side. Another good over for West Indies.
On off, defended.
Fuller and on middle, Dottin pushes it back to the bowler.
Quick run! Not sure Dottin liked that. Length and on middle, this is pushed towards cover and the batters take off. Dottin is quick enough to make it even with the sore back.
FOUR! Caressed! Beautiful stroke! That raced away! Fuller and outside off, this is driven hard through cover-point for a boundary.
Fuller and on middle, this is played back to the bowler.
Hit hard but to mid off! On off, Dottin finds mid off. A dot to end but the damage was done earlier on.
FOUR! Over the off side this time. Consecutive overs with two boundaries in it! Too much width outside off and fuller. Dottin lofts it over covers.
FOUR! Powered! Put away with disdain. Length and on middle, Dottin stands tall and hammers it over mid-wicket for a boundary.

That is outstanding stuff from Jhulan Goswami! Got the last one in and this time gets it to leave the batter. The length is immaculate and so is the line as it lands around off. Dottin is beaten as she tries to defend.
Gets this one to jag back in nicely! Length and outside off, it lands and comes backin. Dottin looks to put bat on ball but misses to get hit on the pads.
Slightly shorter and on the body, Hayley Matthews pulls it down to fine leg for one.
A dot to end but Windies are off to a good start here! Good length and on off, blocked.

EDGY FOUR! Smriti Mandhana should have done better! Fuller again and gets it to shape away from around off, Dottin looks to drive, this flies off the outside edge down to third man. Mandhana runs to her left, dives but fails to stop it. Second boundary in the over.
Better from Singh! Goes fuller and gets it to shape away. Dottin looks to drive but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Good length and on off, Dottin stays back and pushes it to covers.
FOUR! Smashed away! This is short and outside off, asking to be hit. Dottin hangs back and hammers it through covers for a boundary.
Half an appeal but nothing! Shorter and outside off, shaping away. Dottin throws her bat at it but is beaten.
Meghna Singh to bowl from the other end.
A length ball, around off. Hayley Matthews defends it out watchfully.
A length ball, outside off. Hayley Matthews pushes it through covers for a brace.
A length ball, around off, nips in sharply. Hayley Matthews stays inside the crease. She tries to heave it across the line but misses and gets hit above her thigh pad.
Full length, outside off. Hayley Matthews defends it out solidly.

Length ball,on leg yet again. Deandra Dottin clips it behind square on the leg side for a single. Deandra Dottin looks to have a niggle. She is trying to stretch it out and hopefully she should be fine to continue.

Deandra Dottin and West Indies Women are off the mark! A length ball, on the pads, Deandra Dottin flicks it to deep square leg. Hayley Matthews calls for the second run. Deandra Dottin pushes really hard for the second run and completes it.
